field_candidates.name: FFVI
field_candidates.brief: Very compact classic 16-bit Final Fantasy VI-like field sprite proportions: approximately 2 heads tall, tiny 20x28 logical pixels, bold readable silhouettes, 3 tones per material, minimal face marks, very chunky discrete pixel blocks. Cute but not baby-like.
field_candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A field-sprite STYLE CANDIDATE SHEET for Chrono Chain. The two attached character sheets are authoritative identity/outfit references. Only use their DEFAULT black and cobalt blue uniform outfits, never their summer, winter, or shadow forms. Kang Chuheun: male, tousled charcoal-grey hair, amber eyes, black wrap jacket with strong cobalt-blue diagonal collar, blue cuffs and hem, dark trousers, orange-and-white sneakers, short hanging dark blue metal chain attached to anatomical LEFT wrist. Kim Yeonwoo: female, long straight charcoal black hair, small single gold hair clip, amber eyes, black wrap top with cobalt blue collar cuffs and hem, black skirt with blue trim, exposed lower legs, black lace-up ankle boots, dark blue metallic chain attached to LEFT wrist. Keep these details constant; no gold outfit trim.
EXACTLY 4 columns x 2 rows with generous transparent gutter. Top row ONLY Chuheun, bottom row ONLY Yeonwoo. Columns for each character: 1 front-facing relaxed standing, 2 right-facing three-quarter walking stride, 3 back-facing standing, 4 strong rightward chain-cast attack, wrist extended and a short taut straight metal chain showing the attack axis. All full bodies, feet aligned in each row, same proportions in all columns. Transparent background. No shadows, floor, panels, text, labels, logos, extra items. This is original character art with a proposed retro rendering approach, not existing game characters. Intentional large square pixel clusters, nearest-neighbor enlargement, no smooth painted gradients, no anti-alias blur. 
STYLE A: Very compact classic 16-bit Final Fantasy VI-like field sprite proportions: approximately 2 heads tall, tiny 20x28 logical pixels, bold readable silhouettes, 3 tones per material, minimal face marks, very chunky discrete pixel blocks. Cute but not baby-like.

battle.chuheun:
Production BATTLE ANIMATION sprite atlas for Chrono Chain. Attached character sheet is authoritative identity reference; use DEFAULT outfit ONLY. Kang Chuheun, male with tousled charcoal grey hair, amber eyes, black wrap jacket blue diagonal collar/cuffs/hem, orange inset, black trousers, orange-white sneakers. Blue steel chain wraps the anatomical LEFT wrist. All outfit trim MUST be cobalt blue, not gold. Detailed premium 32-bit JRPG pixel animation, visible anime facial expression, 5-head-tall proportions, deliberate discrete pixel clusters, no painterly blur. Intended logical sprite height about 112px, nearest-neighbor enlarged.
EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen equally spaced cells on a square canvas. Every full-body sprite in its own cell. ALL poses face screen RIGHT in consistent 3/4 side view. Consistent head size, character height and outfit across ALL frames. Feet land on same baseline within each row, fixed camera. Generous transparent margins and no sprites touching cell edges. NO text labels, grid, background, cast shadows, magic, weapons other than 3 tiny chain links extending from left wrist. Long chain is rendered by game, do not draw it.
Row1: (0) alert relaxed ready stance, knees soft, hands waist level; (1) same stance subtle inhale shoulder rise and hair shift, feet unchanged; (2) solid defensive guard, left forearm raised across chest; (3) recoil from hit leaning backward with grimace, feet planted.
Row2 is one coherent attack sequence with same feet and same body size: (4) preparation turn hips back, left wrist drawn toward rear hip; (5) strong coiling windup left elbow bent chest height, rear shoulder loaded; (6) full extension strike towards RIGHT, left arm straight at chest height, body committed forward, palm clenched, left blue cuff clear; (7) follow through still facing right, left arm extended slightly lower, hair trailing.
Row3: (8) retract left elbow back to ready, settle stance; (9) gather focus hands close to chest, intense eyes; (10) special skill left hand lifted overhead, full-body stretch, upward intent; (11) special skill release arm thrust diagonally upward-right, feet planted.
Row4: (12) low fast dash pose facing right, legs bent and hair streaming left; (13) landing crouch with one knee bent and left hand low; (14) confident victory stance, small restrained smile, left wrist raised; (15) defeated kneel, exhausted lowered head, no gore.
Transparent background with genuinely empty alpha around each individual sprite. A mechanically usable animation sheet, not a concept illustration. Keep entire body inside each cell. No added jewellery, no alternative clothing.
